reading.body:
This facility has no published power capacity, square footage, or technical specifications. The operator Rowan Green Data LLC maintains no reachable website, and no independent source describes this campus by name. The location places it in Morrow County, Oregon, an area with substantial commercial data center development including reported Amazon infrastructure, but this specific facility cannot be verified beyond its geocoded address on Tower Road.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which only 8 publish power capacity figures totaling 156.6 MW. This campus would rank ninth by published capacity in the state if its capacity were known, but it is not. The ranking reflects only that other facilities in the state registry have disclosed their power consumption and this one has not.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. The grid constraint that binds AI deployment to power availability cannot be evaluated where power figures are absent from the operator's own disclosures.
